svg.title: yak preview
svg.desc: A Title written with styled-components syntax. At build time, yak moves its styles, with the nested hover rule, into a plain CSS file, and the component keeps only a class name. In the browser, hover is plain CSS and no JavaScript runs.

g.text: Styles live next to the component.
yak writes a plain CSS file
The component keeps only a class name.
Hover is plain CSS. No JavaScript runs.
